purpose: Cover the blueprint badge on every REQ row and the by-blueprint grouping (bucket per applied blueprint plus Project bucket, capability second level, hash round-trip, /product-map/blueprint partial endpoint) for AC-17008-1.
title: Product Map by-blueprint grouping and blueprint badge

testCases.description: In the shape grouping rendered over a fixture project that applies one blueprint contributing two REQs, both contributed REQ rows carry a pm-blueprint-badge in their summary while the project's own REQ rows do not.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map: blueprint badge on every contributed REQ row across groupings (AC-17008-1)

testCases.description: The by-blueprint grouping over a fixture with one applied blueprint (2 contributed REQs) and 2 project REQs renders exactly two buckets: a blueprint bucket with count 2 and a Project bucket with count 2.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map: by-blueprint grouping yields one bucket per applied blueprint plus a Project bucket (AC-17008-1)

testCases.description: Inside each by-blueprint bucket the second level is capability (existing capability:<slug> tags), then requirement rows, then the usual drill-down.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map: by-blueprint bucket second level is capability then REQ (AC-17008-1)

testCases.description: The inline script's PM_GROUPS constant lists 'blueprint', the lazy fetch endpoint /product-map/blueprint is exposed on the pre-rendered pmPartials, and renderProductMapGrouping(model, 'blueprint') returns a non-empty string.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map: by-blueprint grouping wired into PM_GROUPS, pmPartials and renderProductMapGrouping (AC-17008-1)

testCases.description: A project with no applied blueprints (manifest.blueprints empty) renders the by-blueprint grouping with a single Project bucket and no error banner.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/product-map.test.js::product-map: by-blueprint grouping on a project with no applied blueprints renders a single Project bucket (AC-17008-1)
